Equipment:
 Vertical Rotary Regenerative Air 
 Heater
 Ljungstrom

This document lists
the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must performed on an annually 
bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The Ljungstrom 
air heater absorbs waste heat from flue gas, then transfers this heat to 
incoming cold air to increase the temperature of the incoming combustion or 
air process.

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. 
Emad El din Ali Elbana, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by 
EDEPC 
inspection & quality control 
at eng Samir Abd El- Gelil, Approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of Abu Soltan Power Station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al 
Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

Technical Specification of 
the Vertical Rotary Regenerative Air Heater Ljungstrom

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

Complete maintenance tool set

sections.text:
Before 
Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically and Electrically

items:
Check any abnormal 
 noise or vibration.

Check any air or flue 
 gases leakage from manholes.

Check the oil 
 level of upper guide bearing.

Check the oil 
 level of Lower support bearing.

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit.

Check the 
 temperature of the upper and lower bearing should be ≤ 50
oC

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit for blowing equipment.

Check 
 auxiliary drive in service for a few minutes.

Check pressure after 
 and before blowing orifice plate.

Cheek leakage steam 
 from the steam admission valves and blowing equipment.

Cheek any leakage oil 
 from drive unit of air heater.

Cheek any leakage oil 
 from upper and lower bearing

Cleaning air filters 
 of air supply once a gear figure (10) or if it required check the level of oil 
 fog lubricators and increase it if required for air line to air motor

Cheek the rotor pin 
 gear and meshing between the pinion gear and rotor pin and check pinion air

Cheek the nozzle and

Cheek and lubricate

sections.text: Return Regenerative Air Heater into Service

items:
Operate the 
 regenerative air heater by coordination with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the
 regenerative air heater is 
 OK and record the readings of clearance, temp., vibration, ... etc, and 
 compare with ref. values.
